mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, consignee, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) values (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})
mapper.select: select od.name as name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time < #{end} group by od.name order by number desc, od.name asc limit 10
